correctness.rationale: The graph-induced full wreath group and the link/deletion formulas follow directly from vertex adjacency. The standard path fold gives integral sphere/contractible homotopy types. For path reflection, the signed fixed-face count reduces to a 6-periodic independence-polynomial recurrence, yielding explicit integral ±1 degrees. Integral joins give Koszul permutation signs. Cofiber exactness and strict dimension separation for m≥2 give the claimed integral homology modules; invariant rational quotient homology follows by transfer. The bundled checker tests mod-two Betti ranks and the full signed Lefschetz traces for 10 small graph instances with all 8 or 48 automorphisms in each instance. Numerical tests are not used to claim a universal theorem.

value.rationale: A coherent complete two-parameter automorphism-module classification on a natural graph family, with sharp mod-12 full-quotient rational homology and an independently verifiable correction of a direct literature boundary case. Unlike arbitrary finite ranks, the group characters carry structural information unavailable from sphere-wedge homotopy type alone, and the link-length issue changes a named canonical example. No paper-sized downstream theorem is asserted or needed.
